summary: Tested Cari dengan Foto (photo search) end to end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Searching with the 300x300 image of indexed product pgs-48799 puts it first at 95% (pgs-51962 is in the top 3). The response returns at most 20 items plus `indexed`, with in-stock items before out-of-stock. Jombang (X-Store-Id) price and stock come from store_stock (334000, stock 2), while Sidoarjo shows 332000. An unknown store id falls back to pgs-official. A TEST_ product limited to the Jember branch shows up only for pgs-jember, not for Jombang or Sidoarjo. A non-image file and a file over 10MB both return 400 with the expected messages; a missing file returns 422. /admin/image-index works for admin, returns 403 for a customer and 401/403 without login. Search takes about 1.2s. Frontend at 390x844: the camera buttons home-photo-search, global-photo-search (/product/pgs-9955) and search-photo-search all open /cari-foto, and back returns to the product page with no double navigation. ps-camera and ps-gallery are 175x48. Uploading through ps-gallery shows the preview, '20 produk paling mirip' and 20 ps-hit-* cards, with pgs-48799 first at 'Kemiripan 95%'. Product images load. With Jombang selected, cards show Mitra PGS Jombang, Jombang stock 2 and Rp320.720-Rp334.000, and the request carries X-Store-Id: pgs-jombang. On web, ps-camera also opens the file chooser. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-image-picker is used).

minor.issue: 2087 products have a first image named '*-scaled.jpg'. _thumb() turns it into '*-scaled-300x300.jpg', which returns 404 (the real thumbnail is '*-300x300.jpg' without '-scaled'). The indexer then downloads the full scaled image instead (~250KB vs ~16KB, measured for pgs-48799), which slows the first index run a lot. Fix: strip '-scaled' in the regex, or use p['image'], which already holds the 300x300 thumbnail.

A product whose photo downloads all fail, even from a temporary network or 5xx error, is marked 'failed:<sig>' and is never retried until its photos change. Consider retrying failed items on later runs, e.g. once a day.

While indexing runs, every batch marks the matrix dirty, so the next search reloads every vector from Mongo while holding the lock. That is fine now (~1.2s with 816 indexed) but will slow down as the index grows toward ~15-20k vectors. Concurrent searches wait on the lock. Possible fix: rebuild at most every N seconds, or add new rows incrementally.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, picking a file that is not an image (forced through the chooser) makes expo-image-picker throw an uncaught 'Unsupported file type: text/plain' and the dev red overlay appears. In real browsers the accept=image/* filter usually prevents this. gallery() and camera() have no try/catch, so any rejection from the picker is unhandled. Wrap them in try/catch and setErr.

issues: The 'Kemiripan xx%' label is 11px muted text outside the card border, which is easy to miss. Consider a badge inside the card or at least 12-13px text.

action_items: Fix _thumb for '-scaled' images, or use p['image'], to avoid 404s and full-size downloads for about 2087 products
Add try/catch around ImagePicker launch calls in cari-foto.tsx
Optional: throttle matrix rebuilds while indexing is in progress
critical_code_review_comments: image_search.py: the top 600 vectors are deduplicated per product, then filtered by _visible('all', branch). This is correct for branch isolation, but if many of the top 600 are hidden by the filter, fewer than 20 results can come back. That is acceptable.
The nested Pressable inside global-search works on web: only /cari-foto is pushed.
app.json has cameraPermission/photosPermission set for expo-image-picker and NSCameraUsageDescription.
